name: Yash Khadagta
role: AI & Machine Learning Engineer | Software Developer
tagline: I build AI-powered applications and machine learning systems that solve real-world problems.
about:
I'm a final-year B.Tech Computer Science student at Poornima Institute of Engineering & Technology, Jaipur, interested in building practical AI applications and reliable software.

At Celebal Technologies, I worked on a RAG-based loan advisory chatbot that answers questions using official banking documents. At KisTechno Software, I worked on an AI-powered phishing-detection system combining a machine-learning model with Google Safe Browsing.

I enjoy taking projects from problem definition to implementation, connecting machine learning with useful interfaces, APIs, and data workflows. I'm focused on strengthening my engineering fundamentals while building software that is useful beyond a demo.

experience.title: Data Science Intern
points: Developed an AI-powered loan advisory chatbot using RAG, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Sentence Transformers, FAISS, and a GRU-based intent classifier.
Built a PDF processing and semantic retrieval pipeline to generate answers grounded in banking documents, with source attribution in a Streamlit interface.

experience.title: AI/ML Developer
points: Developed a phishing-detection browser middleware using a Random Forest model trained on a dataset of more than 2 million URLs.
Integrated Google Safe Browsing API checks into the URL classification workflow.
